frame_note: Both readings taken in one session, seconds apart (XRPL 12:03:24Z, Ethereum 12:03:31Z). XRPL and Ethereum are SEPARATE DEPLOYMENTS of one issuer (Ripple); this frame is same-session, not a cross-date gap story. No claim that the two chains move together beyond these two instants.
subject: RLUSD

trustline_reading.scope_note: account_lines sum = balances over paged trust lines only; may silently truncate on public clusters. Trust-line count is not a holder count and a paged line sum is not net obligations (gateway_balances).
trustline_reading.holders_note: Trust-line count is not a holder count: one account can hold several lines and custodial lines aggregate many holders. Holder count not established by this method.

method_disagreement.explanation: Public-cluster account_lines pagination silently truncates for this issuer (xrplcluster.com stopped at 24 pages; s1.ripple.com still incomplete at 80 pages with sum ~65.1M). gateway_balances obligations agreed across three independent endpoints (xrplcluster.com, s2.ripple.com:51234, xrpl.ws) at the same ledger. Both readings preserved; obligations is the supply-scale figure, the paged line sum is a trust-line-population reading.
